name: Ricardo Velez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying electrical engineering at the National University of Colombia, he became fascinated by the intricate electronic systems in racing cars. After graduation, he worked for a local automotive company before landing a role with a small Colombian racing team. His meticulous approach to problem-solving and his ability to diagnose complex electronic issues quickly earned him a reputation as a reliable and competent engineer.

He joined Anderson Racing five years ago, bringing with him a wealth of experience in diagnosing and optimizing electronic systems. Ricardo believes in a hands-on approach, always preferring to be in the garage, analyzing data and fine-tuning the car's electronics. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to explain complex technical issues in a clear and concise manner, making him a valuable asset to the team. Ricardo's deep understanding of race car electronics combined with his systematic approach sets him apart.

physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a focused gaze and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with circuit diagrams.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working on complex problems.
Insists on using a specific brand of multimeter, claiming it's 'more accurate'.
